roles.title: AI Software Engineer (Volunteer)
roles.description: I build and run production software for the congregation, including a PWA with live chat, push notifications and RAG-based Voice AI.
highlights: Built, deployed and maintain a production PWA for 20+ users with live chat, push notifications and RAG-based Voice AI answering Vietnamese questions from English PDFs with citations.
Isolated each tenant's data via Postgres RLS.
Built and deployed a resilient AI microservice with multi-provider failover and exponential backoff on Oracle Cloud using Docker, ensuring 99.9% uptime during LLM outages.
Cut pgvector search from 1.2s to 0.25s using connection pools.
Ran user acceptance interviews with congregation members and translated feedback into a prioritized backlog, so every release shipped against criteria users had approved beforehand.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
roles.description: Global nonprofit with an 11-person software team serving 300 active users in 100+ countries on an enterprise Vue / C# .NET / SQL Server platform.
highlights: Made the Planning dashboard load its data 20x faster (10s to 0.5s) and cut its chart's database reads 93% by fixing a misplanned SQL Server query and removing duplicate API calls.
Shipped a flag-gated request tracer (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger) across 14 .NET repos; 3 teammates used it to cut load times 50–70% on 3 pages.
Remediated a critical security vulnerability by optimizing O(n²) algorithms to O(n) and adding request throttling, while delivering 40+ other production features and fixes.
Partnered with a product owner and business analyst to modernize a legacy .NET permissions module, turning workflow complaints into approved designs, user stories and specs.
As an intern, restored 150,000 asset relationships for 22,666 assets with a Python ETL pipeline on the Bynder API, saving an estimated 200+ hours of manual re-linking.
As an intern, delivered 15+ production features and fixes on an enterprise reporting engine, enforcing row-level security and writing unit tests in Azure DevOps CI/CD.
